title: Sufi Movement Causes Of Creation
definition: The Sufi movement was a mystical dimension of Islam (Tasawwuf) that emerged as a reaction against the growing materialism, legalism, and political centralization of the Umayyad and Abbasid Caliphates, emphasizing direct personal experience of God.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the socio-religious synthesis in Medieval India, the evolution of syncretic culture (Ganga-Jamuni Tehzeeb), and the interaction between Islamic mysticism and the Bhakti movement.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sufi Movement Causes Of Creation.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
